summary: ReportQueue is a web UI module for managing, viewing, filtering, and acting on queued print jobs and delivered reports within the HSPnet system. It provides users with tools to filter by status, user, report type, and actions such as marking reports as delivered, emailing reports, or deleting them.
purpose: To enable users (typically staff) to view, filter, and take actions (such as email, mark delivered, delete) on queued print jobs and reports, grouped by delivery status and recipient. The module organizes reports into categories (to be delivered, delivered, others) and provides a UI for batch or individual operations.

workflows.name: Viewing and Filtering Reports
steps: User selects filters: report name, user, delivery/viewed/submitted status.
The UI displays reports grouped by delivery categories.
User can toggle group visibility, sort by columns, and view summaries.

workflows.name: Taking Action on Selected Reports
steps: User selects one or more reports (checkboxes).
User chooses action from ddAction (Mark Delivered, Mark Undelivered, Email to Default/Specific Recipient, Delete Permanently).
System processes action, updates report status, triggers email or deletion, and refreshes the view.

workflows.name: Emailing Reports
steps: User selects reports and chooses Email action.
System checks for readiness and recipient validity.
If all checks pass, system opens/email popup, hashes URL, and sends email.
If not, alerts are shown for missing recipient or not-ready status.

workflows.name: Deleting Reports
steps: User selects reports and chooses 'Delete Permanently'.
System verifies user is permitted (not viewing as another user).
Reports are deleted and queue refreshed.

business_rules: Only users with appropriate permissions may delete reports.
Reports may only be emailed if marked as 'Ready'.
Default recipient must be set before emailing multiple reports.
Category summaries show counts of 'to be delivered', 'delivered', and 'other' reports.
validations: Check if at least one report is selected before performing an action.
Alert if attempting to email a report with missing recipient.
Alert if trying to act on a report not marked 'Ready'.
Ensure that delete is only available if user is acting as self.
calculations: FirstCategoryNotDeliveredCount: number of reports to be delivered.
Summaries and totals displayed in UI corresponding to delivery status.
conditions: IsPostBack controls filter and UI population logic.
UserSession settings determine filter defaults and permitted actions.
HideDelete flag set based on user context and permissions.
system_behavior: Page_Load initializes UI and retrieves report queue data.
Page_PreRender resets actions and highlights icons.
SearchReports updates session variables and triggers data refresh.
Repeater control (rprReportQ) binds report data and processes item actions.
On client-side, JavaScript manages selection, group toggling, and email popup logic.
dependencies: HSPnet.DataLayer.PrintJobs for retrieving and updating print jobs.
StaffController.SearchUserDepartment for filling staff user dropdown.
JavaScript and tablesorter libraries for client-side UI.
Resources for localized UI strings and labels.
exceptions: Attempting to email a report without a default recipient shows alert.
Trying to act on reports not ready for delivery shows alert.
Delete action disabled for non-self users or in view-only mode.
Invalid report or user selection prevents action submission.
content_gaps: No explicit database schema for PrintJobs or session variable structure.
Specific permission model for staff not detailed.
Exact email format and delivery operation not shown.
Underlying data structure for report contents, delivery, and status is inferred but not explicitly described.
